paragraphs: The Defender P400e is a plug-in hybrid variant of the L663-generation Defender, introduced in 2020. It combines the Ingenium AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine — with an electric motor, producing a combined output of 404 PS. Production was limited to the 2020 model year and the 110 body style only, making it a relatively rare variant in the Defender range. The Defender P400e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Defender P400e Engine Codes AJ300P + Electric Motor (L663, 2020 only) A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine paired with a plug-in hybrid electric motor, fitted exclusively to the L663-generation Defender 110 in 2020. We rebuild the internal combustion engine component to the same standard as our other Defender petrol rebuilds, with timing chains, bearings and gaskets replaced as standard. Unlike the standard P400, the P400e features a plug-in hybrid drivetrain with additional electrical components. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P + electric motor engines for every Defender P400e on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Defender P400e from 2023 to present. The AJ300P + electric motor features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300P + electric motor V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P + electric motor rebuild.
